_comment: Every source of data coming INTO the business (Reif 2026-09-24: 'I'm especially interested in data inflows; there can't be that many: server, database, Google Analytics...'). Built from evidence, not memory: the app's source pool (src/philanthropy/ops/source_registry.py), the ingest_* and sync crons (scripts/box/crontab, docs/ops/crons.md), env key NAMES on atlas-serve, and outbound API calls in src/. scripts/coverage_map.py scores every row daily from the prod probe capture (scripts/prod_runtime_probe.sh sections cron_exits, crontab, envkeys, signals, inflow_ts): last success is MEASURED -- a cron's last EXIT 0, a live 200 from the app's own /990/api/signals/<name> read endpoint, or the newest row the source wrote -- never assumed. Status: OK | STALE (last success older than fresh_h) | DOWN (measured, never succeeded or failing now) | NO_CREDENTIAL (a `creds` key is not set on the box) | NEVER_CHECKED (the capture carries no measurement). Any non-OK row fails librarian's audit. `owner` is an EXISTING member. `reif_only`: the fix is a credential or account only Reif can supply -- it goes on the single 'needs Reif' list. `need`: exactly what fixes a non-OK row.
